title: capsicum annuum subsp. abbreviatum
intro: Capsicum annuum subsp. abbreviatum, commonly known as the miniature sweet pepper or dwarf sweet pepper, is a subspecies of Capsicum annuum, a plant in the nightshade family. This plant is rich in nutrients and offers various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Capsicum annuum subsp. abbreviatum include analgesic, anti-tumor, and cardiovascular protective effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including capsaicin, flavonoids, and carotenoids. The bioactive constituents of Capsicum annuum subsp. abbreviatum have been shown to have anti-proliferative, anti-apoptotic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
